title: Ledger Note on Valuing a Change Where a Metal Market Repricing Stands on the Commission
content:
# Ledger Note on Valuing a Change Where a Metal Market Repricing Stands on the Commission

A fraction of 0.85, a fraction of 0.7, or no fraction at all is applied to the value reached for an agreed change on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. Which of the three follows turns on whether a repricing for a movement in the metal market stands booked on the commission, and on whether a casting stage stands recorded on it.

## The fractions

1. Where a repricing for a movement in the metal market stands booked on the commission and a casting stage stands recorded on it, the value reached is taken at the studio's late fraction for a market movement already passed on, which is 0.85.
2. Where a repricing for a movement in the metal market stands booked on the commission and no casting stage stands recorded on it, the value reached is taken at the studio's early fraction for a market movement already passed on, which is 0.7.
3. Otherwise the value reached stands as it is.

## What the entries show

A repricing for a movement in the metal market stands booked where the repricings booked to the commission under the metal market reason come to more than nothing. A casting stage stands recorded where an entry for the casting stage of production has been booked to the commission.

## The three cases (hypothetical)

Take a value reached of USD 1000.00 before the fraction is taken.

| Entries on the commission | Fraction | Value |
|---|---|---|
| A metal market repricing of USD 400.00 and a casting stage recorded | 0.85 | USD 850.00 |
| A metal market repricing of USD 400.00 and no casting stage recorded | 0.7 | USD 700.00 |
| No metal market repricing, whether or not a casting stage is recorded | The value reached stands as it is | USD 1000.00 |
